topic: track changes while editing a Word document
core_question: How do I turn on and use Track Changes in Microsoft Word so edits are visible?
answer_summary: Go to the Review tab in Word and click 'Track Changes' before editing; insertions, deletions, and comments are marked and can later be accepted or rejected.
